basic_details.job_title: Anna University Research Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Anna University's Centre for International Relations has circulated notice RCT/CIR/2026 (dated 16.11.2026) inviting applications for a 3-month (90-day) full-time, un-paid International Research Experience in Germany under the RC Trust Internship Programme 2027. Accommodation, living costs and round-trip travel are fully covered. Undergraduate, Masters and PhD students can apply online until 31 December 2026 at rc-trust.ai.

how_to_apply: The notice states that the online application process has commenced.
Visit the programme web page given in the circular, https://rc-trust.ai/career/internship-program, for further details and the online application.
Submit the application on or before 31 December 2026.
The notice does not list documents or give other application steps.

content_sections.heading: About Anna University
content_sections.text: The circular is issued under reference RCT/CIR/2026 and is addressed to all Deans of campuses and all Directors and HODs, with a request to display it on the notice board. The programme itself is conducted by the Research Centre for Trustworthy Data Science and Security, Germany, which is part of the Research Alliance Ruhr. This is an internship for students, not a regular government post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Undergraduate, Masters and PhD students with a background in computer science, statistics, psychology or computer security. Interest in academic research. The working language is English; German is not required. For discipline-specific eligibility, check the official notification and the programme web page.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The internship lasts 3 months (90 days), full time, and is un-paid. Accommodation and living costs are fully covered, and round-trip travel expenses are fully covered. The programme offers work in Trustworthy and explainable AI, Machine Learning, Data science and statistics, Cybersecurity and privacy, and Human-AI interaction. It is conducted at Bochum, Dortmund, or Duisburg-Essen, Germany, and offers international research exposure, interdisciplinary collaboration and networking opportunities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Anna University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice states that the online application process has commenced. Visit the programme web page given in the circular, https://rc-trust.ai/career/internship-program , for further details and the online application. Submit the application on or before 31 December 2026. The notice does not list documents or give other application steps.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RC Trust Internship Programme 2027?
faq.answer: The last date for the application is 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the RC Trust Internship?
faq.answer: Undergraduate, Masters and PhD students with a background in computer science, statistics, psychology or computer security, who are interested in academic research, can apply.

faq.question: Q3. How long is the internship?
faq.answer: The internship is for 3 months (90 days), full time.

faq.question: Q4. Is the RC Trust internship paid?
faq.answer: No, it is a un-paid internship. Accommodation and living costs are fully covered, and round-trip travel expenses are fully covered.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the internship be held?
faq.answer: It will be conducted at Bochum, Dortmund, or Duisburg-Essen, Germany, by the Research Centre for Trustworthy Data Science and Security.

faq.question: Q6. Do I need to know German?
faq.answer: No. The working language is English and German is not required.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online. The notice says the online application process has commenced and gives the web link https://rc-trust.ai/career/internship-program for further details.

faq.question: Q8. Which research areas does the programme cover?
faq.answer: Trustworthy and explainable AI, Machine Learning, Data science and statistics, Cybersecurity and privacy, and Human-AI interaction.
